title: Connector events: ring batches, derived signals, deny records
description: The events channel (C-05.37 to C-05.43). Three families: contract 07's durable ring batches for Activity, the connector's derived live signals for the sidebar's state dots, Needs you and Today, and contract 04's deny records. The derived signals come from the connector's one ring read (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/server/routes/events.js GET /api/events/stream, lib/core/bus.js) and from the status poll (GET /api/mirror/status, GET /api/asks), and carry no word a user or an agent wrote (contract 11).

batch.description: Main-ring entries of one chat's daemon for the hub's durable chat stream (contract 07, C-07.11). Never dropped by the link (C-05.24). Direction: connector to hub.

turn_begun.description: A turn took the chat's lock (C-05.39). Derived from the ring entry {kind:'graph', op:'turn-begin'} (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/server/domain/turns.js). A turn-begin with upgraded_wake_lock: true is the same turn and derives nothing (turns.js:573-577); one with stole_stale_lock: true derives turn.ended with outcome superseded for the held turn first, then this frame. Direction: connector to hub.

boot.description: A daemon's per-boot token as GET /api/health serves it, opaque to the hub (contract 07 and 12-compat.json treat it so; Q-07.8 asks for a random one). Today `<pid>:<epoch ms>` (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/server/index.js:156 bootId). A new value means the ring's seq space restarted (lib/core/bus.js).

daemon_seq.description: The ring seq of the entry this was derived from, so the hub can join it to contract 07's key main/<boot>/<seq>; null when it came from the status poll.

daemon_at.description: The source's own time (a ring entry's ts, a status frame's now), else the connector's receipt time.

author.description: user (the ring entry omits author for a user turn), wake, task, or a later word.

session_id.description: The Claude Code session id, when the entry carries one.

turn_ended.description: A turn let the lock go (C-05.39). Derived from the ring entries {kind:'graph', op:'turn-end'}, {op:'turn-skipped', reason:'no-change'} and {op:'unlock', had:true}, and, as superseded, from {op:'turn-begin', stole_stale_lock:true}, which ends the held turn with no turn-end (turns.js:480-490). A turn-skipped with reason other-session, a turn-begin with upgraded_wake_lock and an unlock with had: false derive nothing. Direction: connector to hub.

outcome.description: committed: op turn-end. skipped_no_change: op turn-skipped with reason no-change (reason other-session leaves the held turn running and derives nothing, turns.js:870-885). superseded: a turn-begin with stole_stale_lock: true took a stale lock; node, ended and ended_by are null and daemon_seq is that turn-begin's seq, or null when the status poll found the lock gone (a guardReaim steal, turns.js:673-682, writes no turn entry; C-05.39). unlocked: op unlock with had: true (had: false derives nothing, turns.js:620-630).

node.description: The node a committed turn made, else null.
